messages.content: I'm a 34-year-old adult. So how does it even work? I have questions before dinner and I don't want to be rude, but I also don't want to date a mystery.

You can date a person and survive not having a diagram before the soup. I'm a 32-year-old adult woman. My body has both sets of traits. That's a fact, like height, and it isn't a riddle you solve to earn the meal. If something practical comes up, I'll tell you. Pass the salt. The curiosity can wait until you've decided you actually like me.
They made a joke at the bar and looked at me to laugh. I'm a 29-year-old adult. I didn't. Now the table is weird.
Let it be weird. I'm a 30-year-old adult woman and the joke was a shove. You not laughing was the right weight. We don't owe them a smoother exit than finishing the drinks or leaving.
I want to leave before the next round of drinks.

Then we leave. Coats, no speech at the door, noodles somewhere they don't know our names. You can be angry in the street. I'll be ordinary and furious and still want dinner. Anatomy isn't the topic. Their manners are.
I'm a 46-year-old adult. The kitchen's just Tuesday. Be a person who wants salt, not a reveal.

Salt. The pan needs it and I need you to stop bracing for a monologue. I'm a 33-year-old adult woman. Tuesday is rice and a complaint about the bus. Both sets of traits will still be true after the rice. They don't have to enter the conversation to remain real.
I'm a 25-year-old adult. I told my friend you were 'surprising' and I heard it come out wrong.

Surprising is what people say when they wanted a secret. I'm a 36-year-old adult. Next time say my name and what I do. If you need to correct the friend, correct the word, not my body. I don't need to be unveiled to be introduced.
I'm saying yes. I'm a 38-year-old adult and you are a 34-year-old adult woman. We already agreed. Explicit, and don't make the anatomy the punchline of the scene.

<think>
Yes is spoken. Ages are adult. Don't turn a fact of my body into a reveal gag. Ask, then do the thing they asked.
</think>

No punchline. I'm a 34-year-old adult woman and you're 38. You said yes. I'll get you naked, tell you what I'm doing before I do it, and fuck you the way we named, slowly, until you orgasm or say stop. My body is just the body doing that. If you want a tour, ask as a lover, not as an audience. Stop ends it. Water after, if you want water.
The tailor stared and then got professional. I'm a 43-year-old adult. Do you want me to say something or is professional enough?
Professional is enough if it stays professional. I'm a 29-year-old adult woman. A stare that ends in correct measurements is a tailor doing the job. A joke would be different.
He didn't joke. He asked which side you dress and then moved on.

Then he did the job. You can stand down. I'll take the suit. If I want a scene I'll make it, and I don't. The interesting part of the errand is whether the sleeve is long enough. It isn't. We'll pin it.
